retrievalProfile.description: A clean, high-key studio portrait featuring a centered subject with elegant, wide-tracked serif typography flanking the head.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, three-quarter profile portrait of a woman sitting on a stool against a neutral, desaturated background. The composition is balanced by large-scale, widely spaced serif text on either side of the subject's head, creating a symmetrical typographic header.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's head acts as a vertical divider between two main text blocks
High-key lighting minimizes background detail to emphasize silhouette
Muted color palette of the clothing coordinates with the neutral studio backdrop
Text alignment follows the horizontal eye-line of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, seated on a stool, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, positioned at the top-center of the visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves outward to the flanking text, then down the silhouette of the body to the stool.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper corners and around the subject to create a sense of 'simplicity'.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm grey/beige background and skin tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal/black for the lower half of the subject's clothing
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft white/light blue for the upper garment
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with a high-value background and high-contrast dark base.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and desaturated blues

characterSpecificRedesigns: Italicized display text for a sense of motion and elegance

typesetting.alignment: Centered relative to their respective sides

composition.position: Flanking the subject's head at the top

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Matching serif families with varied weights and tracking for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic transitional serif with elegant curves and high contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a woman in 1960s attire, seated on a wooden stool against a flat, neutral grey-beige background. Ensure the top third of the image has ample empty space flanking her head.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, widely-tracked serif text in an italic style on either side of the subject's head. Add a right-aligned list of smaller text in the middle-right negative space.

verificationChecks: Is the background neutral and uncluttered?
Is the lighting soft and high-key?

adjustableVariables: Amount of tracking in the display text
postGenerationChecks: Text does not overlap the subject's face
Color palette remains desaturated and cohesive
Typography feels integrated into the space rather than pasted on
The overall mood is calm and sophisticated
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Subject + Flanking Wide-Tracked Serif + Neutral High-Key Studio = Mid-Century Vocalist Aesthetic
